assets.name: wudu
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: wide editorial article cover for a premium Islamic learning website. Primary request: a quiet close-up of fresh clear water pouring from a simple brass tap into a pale cream stone ablution basin in a beautiful mosque courtyard. No people. Composition: landscape 3:2, sculptural brass faucet on the upper right, water centered, soft ripples and negative space on the left. Natural late afternoon sunlight, tactile travertine, subtle cobalt blue tile detail, restrained warm ivory and muted blue palette. High-end architectural editorial photography, authentic materials, crisp detail, calm and thoughtful mood. No words, no Arabic calligraphy, no logos, no watermark.
